reason: A DeepSeek Harness web-chat UI plugin that provides a hover-revealed panel for navigating between user questions and highlights the current conversation position.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面添加悬停展开的快捷导航面板，可按用户提问跳转并高亮当前对话位置。
summaries.en: Adds a hover-revealed quick-navigation panel to DeepSeek Harness web chat for jumping between user questions and highlighting the current conversation position.

capabilities: Adds a hover-triggered navigation panel to the web chat interface
Reads visible chat messages to list user questions and identify the current conversation position
Navigates within the chat to selected messages
